pages.text: The $(thing)Lumenwrights$() are gone; only ruins remain. Find broken $(thing)Vestige Outposts$(), village-sized $(thing)Vestige Cities$() (some Grand, with spires), buried $(thing)Vaults$(), and abandoned $(thing)Luminite Mines$() with liftshafts.

Their material is $(thing)Glowbrick$(), refined from $(thing)Luminite$() ore (ore → raw → smelt to ingot → glowbrick). $(thing)Memory Crystals$() and $(thing)Glyph Tablets$() hold fragments of their story. $(br)$(br)Tip: $(thing)/locate structure lumenwilds:vestige_mine$() finds the nearest city with a mineshaft.
